chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 530: The War's True Cost & Ji Ning's New Role
chapter_meta_description: The war with the Seamless Gate begins with terrible losses. Ji Ning faces an Empyrean God, and the Grand Xia army must confront the brutal arithmetic of a war of attrition.
og_title: The War's True Cost - Desolate Era Ch. 530
og_description: Ji Ning survives his first true clash with an Empyrean God, but the scale of the casualties reshapes the battlefield.
twitter_title: War Grinds On in Desolate Era Ch. 530
twitter_description: A brutal opening clash sets the tone for a grinding war of attrition where legendary immortals die by the hundreds.

lore_anchors.definition: A powerful flood dragon-type Empyrean God under the Seamless Gate's command, capable of using the complete Grand Dao of Blackwater.
One of the nine legions of the Grand Xia army, commanded by the Xi River Celestial Immortal. Heavily mauled in its first engagement.
A refined combat puppet, as tough as a Pure Yang magic treasure. Extremely hard to destroy but vulnerable to binding and suppression techniques.
High-grade pills used by Celestial Immortals and above to replenish ki; massively in demand during a prolonged war.
A supreme Fiendgod divine ability focusing on body hardening and indestructibility. Ji Ning is using the pills to fuel its advancement.
The Seamless Gate's mobile fortress-battleship, described as a floating black city. A symbol of their power in this war.
